messages:
{Rosie}: Quick note — change window tomorrow 09:00-12:00 UTC. Planning a staged canary for release v5.2.0. Requesting deploybot safety-mode for the window and a pinned fallback to the last stable. @Sam @Maria pls ack. Proposed canary: 10% for 30m -> 40% for 20m -> 100% if green.

{Sam}: Ack. I'll be on infra oncall 08:30-11:30 UTC. Suggest adding a 10m quiet period between stages for quick smoke and logs sampling.

{Maria}: Ack from product. I'll run post-stage behavioral checks and a quick eval script after each stage. 10m quiet period sounds good.

{Jordan}: Recommend we auto-pin 5.1.8 as the rollback target and enable a fast re-pin command. Also, let's capture canary metrics to the release dashboard.

{Rosie}: Good. Command I plan to run: `/deploybot safety-mode enable --window 2024-11-04T09:00Z/2024-11-04T12:00Z --fallback 5.1.8 --notify #eng-releases`

{Deploybot}: safety-mode ENABLED by Rosie at 1719006789. Canary job queued. Fallback pin set: 5.1.8. Job id: `deploy:job:1719006799`.

{Lee-SRE}: Rollback roster: Sam (infra), Maria (product), Jordan (runtime). Escalation path: Lee -> Eng Lead -> CTO. Short playbook: 
1) Pause canary: `/deploybot pause <job id>`
2) Re-pin stable: `/deploybot pin 5.1.8`
3) Shift traffic back to stable pool and run smoke checks
4) Create incident and assign postmortem to release owner

{Sam}: I'll create a runbook entry with exact commands and be at my desk by 08:20. Also will monitor infra alerts and latency dashboards.

{Maria}: I'll post the smoke checklist and the evaluation script in #runbooks by EOD and add quick pass/fail criteria.

{Rosie}: Thanks. One more: please confirm any scheduled infra maintenance in that window — don't want overlapping change windows. If anything changes ping this thread. :wave:
